offering_description.value: Acadian manages investments for pension plans, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations and other institutions. It uses quantitative models to build and manage equity, credit and alternative portfolios through separate accounts and pooled funds.

primary_products.value: Systematic equity funds; systematic credit funds; alternative investment funds

primary_services.value: Institutional portfolio management; customized separate-account management; investment subadvisory

customer_segment.value: B2B: Corporate pension plans, endowments, foundations, asset managers and other institutional investors; B2G: Public pension plans and sovereign wealth funds

end_markets.value: Retirement and pensions; sovereign investment; endowment and foundation investing; asset management

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: Asset-based fees for managing portfolios and performance fees on certain mandates

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: Invests institutional client capital in securities through pooled funds and separate accounts

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific, including offices in the United States, United Kingdom, Singapore and Australia

specialization.value: related lines: Systematic equity, credit and alternative strategies that share a quantitative investment approach

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Institutional client teams serving asset owners and investment managers; partners / resellers: Third-party asset managers that offer Acadian-managed strategies through subadvisory arrangements

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Investment adviser registration and oversight by the U.S. SEC and applicable overseas regulators
